name: incident
description: One incident: the grouped alerts, their facts, and what the investigation found.

severity.instructions: How large is the impact on event participants?
criteria: everyone or a core service down

page_now.instructions: Should the owning team be mentioned (paged) right now, rather than this waiting for the next summary?

primary_team.instructions: Which team should lead this incident?

criteria.server: servers and services: Kubernetes, Kea, Unbound, NTP, syslog
criteria.wifi: access points and the wireless controller
criteria.external: an upstream or third party outside our control

cause_class.instructions: What kind of cause is most likely?

criteria.link: a physical link, optic or cable
criteria.peer: the other side: upstream, peer, federation or provider
criteria.client: one client or a few misbehaving clients
